content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe operates in only 46 countries, which excludes a vast majority of the global population. This limitation presents a significant hurdle for creators in restricted regions. PayPal, while more widely accessible, can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal, creating a precarious situation for sellers. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, provides a comprehensive solution that is not bound by geographical restrictions. It allows creators to set up their own online stores with integrated payment processing, file delivery, and full ownership of their data, bypassing arbitrary exclusions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Most conventional platforms are unwilling to engage with markets perceived as high-risk, leading to a systemic exclusion of creators in countries like Bangladesh and Venezuela. Stripe and PayPal often cite regulatory concerns, but the real impact is the stifling of creativity and entrepreneurship in those regions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH instead focuses on enabling creators regardless of their geographical location. By leveraging decentralized payment solutions and open-source technology, these creators can build and maintain their businesses without the fear of being shut down or left in limbo.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed varies significantly across platforms. Stripe typically offers instant payment processing in supported countries, yet for those excluded, the wait can be indefinite. PayPal's suspension policies can further delay access to funds, resulting in cash flow issues for creators. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, particularly through NOWPayments, allows creators to receive payments in real-time, with minimal transaction fees of just 0.5%. This efficiency enables faster market entry and reduces the financial strain associated with delayed payments.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates platform dependency.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical differentiator between conventional platforms and sovereign commerce solutions. Once a creator deploys their store using the Edge Commerce Stack, they retain full control over their data and operations. Conventional platforms often hold a portion of the creator's content, limiting their agency. Automated delivery systems also come into play; while platforms like Gumroad handle delivery for you, they control the entire process. Sovereign infrastructure automates product delivery while ensuring that creators maintain ownership and autonomy over every aspect of their transactions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture hinges on individual needs. If you require a quick and straightforward setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is an excellent entry point. For more advanced needs with additional features, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a robust solution. Ultimately, selecting a sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to bypass the limitations imposed by conventional platforms, ensuring long-term viability and control over their digital businesses.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Full data ownership means your content is yours, forever.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
